integrity: The universal result is proved analytically from an exact determinant factorization and a subgroup-union estimate. Finite enumeration is used only as a sanity check and not as proof of the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only families of subsets of cardinality two.
It does not give quantitative Riesz conditioning bounds for the simultaneous basis.
An equivalent observation may exist under different terminology in literature not recovered by the searches.
title: A sharp \(p\)-threshold for simultaneous exponential bases of two-point subsets
